title: Ben's Sign for the Seeds
synopsis: Ben creates a sign far too large for their small garden, while Grandma May helps the children plant radish and sunflower seeds with sensible row labels.
continuity_state: Before: The Story House garden site is approved and mapped, but no seeds planted. The old clay pot is nearby; Ben has a very large paper sign prepared at home. After: In mild late-spring conditions, Grandma May supervises planting radishes in the front row and sunflowers in the back, with space and two picture labels. Small sign on path-side peg reads LITTLE GROWING GARDEN. Grown-up waters gently. Ben takes oversized carrot sign home; garden has seeds but no visible seedlings.

related_resources.reason: Radishes grow from planted seeds and are not immediately visible at sowing; University of Minnesota Extension documents radish direct seeding, emergence and growing conditions.
Plant-identification tags are described in seed-starting guidance, though the story uses original picture labels outside in a tiny garden.
